eras.note: Alaska's 20 Senate districts are each a fixed pairing of two adjacent House districts, not independently drawn — same enactment history as the House map. Veto override isn't per-chamber — it's a joint session of the combined 60-member Legislature: 2/3 (40 of 60) for general bills, 3/4 (45 of 60) for revenue/appropriations bills. The 40 shown here is that joint-session threshold, not a Senate-only figure.

redistricting.text: A new footprint: none of its population was in the 2016–2020 A; it draws from the old R (97%), the old P (2%), the old Q (1%). Counties: gained Ketchikan Gateway (38%), Sitka (23%), Prince of Wales-Hyder (16%) and 3 more; lost Fairbanks North Star. 2020 presidential margin R+11.9 on the 2016–2020 lines → R+4.5 on the current lines.
